content.title: Read a value
content.text:
Consider:

```html
<label for="name">Name</label>
<input id="name" />
```

JavaScript can read the current value:

```js
const nameInput = document.querySelector("#name");
console.log(nameInput.value);
```

content.question: If the user types `Ada` into the input, what does `nameInput.value` contain?
